The distant future, 5012. The sudden aerial invasion of Earth by ＜Aliens＞ and their creations ＜Machine Lifeforms＞led mankind to the brink of extinction. The surviving number of humans who took refuge on the moon to organize a counterattack using ＜android＞ soldiers to recapture Earth. However, the war reaches a stalemate as the ＜Machine Lifeforms＞ continue to multiply infinitely. In turn, humanity deploys anew unit of android soldiers as an ultimate weapon: ＜YoRHa＞ Newly dispatched to Earth ＜2B＞ joins＜9S＞, the analyst currently stationed there, where amid their mission, they encounter a myriad of mysterious phenomena... This is the story of these lifeless ＜androids＞ and their endless fight for the sake of mankind. (Source: NieR:Automata Ver1.1a Official USA Website) Note: Episodes 9, 10, 11, 12 aired back-to-back on July 23, 2023.

The anime is set in Bayron City, an artificial island city established, outside of any country's jurisdiction, in the Pacific Ocean to exploit local natural resources. In particular, the mining of the new energy resource orgonium has resulted in an outbreak of "D disasters" by demons in the city. Private military companies (PMCs) are tasked with dealing with these incidents.
The protagonist Shuu runs a small PMC, though his spending habits have left him constantly penniless. A demon girl named Kisara does contract work at Shuu's office and is constantly worried for him. Kisara attends a high school in Bayron City, and does everything from clerical work to household chores with confidence. Meanwhile, Ayano is Shuu's ex-girlfriend, an elite agent, and a former work colleague in a major PMC that Shuu used to work for.
(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Slice of Life

MgRonald’s best demon lord worker is back, climbing the corporate ladder to become ruler of Earth. But Maou’s plans of domination might need to be put on hold when a small girl claims to be his and Emi’s child! (Source: Crunchyroll)
Kimi wo Aishita Hitori no Boku e

Koyomi Hidaka and Shiori Sato meet at his father’s research center and begin to fall in love, but so do their parents, who eventually marry. To avoid becoming stepsiblings, they decide to run away to a parallel universe. Traveling between dimensions is common in their world, but not without repercussions. Does a universe exist for the young couple, and what will it cost them to find it?
(Source: Crunchyroll)

Hiroto Domori is a seemingly weakling Irregular who doesn’t have any magical or spiritual powers. But what most people don’t know is that he just got back from the demon world and is the world's strongest demon killer.
This "weak" demon killer goes up against an unrivaled enemy who attacks innocent people.
The battle between lessers and the strongest!
(Source: Manga UP!)

Dungeons and monsters suddenly appear and the world falls into chaos. Ki-Bong Kim, an ordinary young part-timer, has been sucked up into an awakening dimension for 3000 years to train his powers. When he makes his return to reality, he is a max-leveled player who only has one wish -- to reconcile with his loved ones. 10 years have passed in the real world during his absence. How will Ki-Bong be able to find his place in the world with his new limit-breaking abilities?
(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
